title: Honor exact platform resource authority for admin service principals

phases.objective: Allow high-risk capability resolution to accept an exact bounded platform resource-authority binding for a service principal without weakening tenant/user workspace-grant requirements or independent dispatch gates.

e2e_journeys.actor: Governed platform admin service principal resolving a high-risk repository mutation capability
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: capability-resolution-dry-run authority evaluation for an exact GitHub repository, recipe and operation mode
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: An active exact service-principal binding removes only the high-risk resource-authority and elevated-permission gaps; mismatched, expired, wildcard, tenant/user or absent bindings remain blocked and dispatch certification stays independent.
steps: Evaluate a typed platform_admin_service principal with an active exact repository binding for repo_patch_batch_apply and atomic_change_set.
Verify exact tenant, workspace, principal, resource type, repository URI, recipe, allowed mode and sufficient permission before accepting platform resource authority.
Repeat with resource, expiry, recipe and mode mismatches, then with wildcard resource or wildcard mode authority, and assert each case fails closed.
Evaluate a tenant/user principal with no workspace grant alongside the service binding and assert that the platform binding is not borrowed across principal types.
Evaluate the service principal without an exact binding and with a genuine strong workspace grant to prove the intended OR boundary.
Assert dispatch certification remains a separate blocking gate when resource authority succeeds.
assertions: An exact active service-principal binding removes workspace_resource_grant_missing_for_high_risk_operation and elevated_permission_missing for the covered high-risk repository operation.
The same successful resource-authority evaluation does not remove dispatch_certification_missing_or_not_allowed when no qualifying certification exists.
Resource URI, recipe or operation-mode mismatch and expired bindings do not authorize the operation.
Wildcard repository URIs and wildcard allowed modes do not authorize the operation.
Tenant/user principals without a workspace resource grant remain blocked even when an unrelated service-principal platform binding exists.
A service principal without an exact platform binding remains blocked unless it has a real strong workspace resource grant.
Legacy untyped principal-id input does not infer service identity from its name and qualifies only when the exact persisted binding proves principal_type=service for the same principal id.
The change performs no database migration, Production database write, deployment, provider call, credential read or mutation, protected-ref bypass, wildcard authority seed, or OpenAPI change.
